rows.text: with `k` = `edx`, dispatching on `k` - 1 through the jump table at image base + `0x67D84C`, returns as a float: for `k` 1 to 6 the signed dword at `rcx` + 0x414, 0x420, 0x42C, 0x418, 0x424 and 0x430 divided by 255 (`008C5B40`); for `k` 7 to 10 the signed dword at +0x41C, +0x428, +0x434 and +0x438 divided by 1023 (`00D6B968`); for `k` 17 and 18 the zero-extended byte +0x44D and byte +0x44E divided by 255; 0.0 for every other `k` (11 to 16, and `k` - 1 above 0x11 unsigned)

corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body is right otherwise (table, offsets, divisors 255.0/1023.0, k 17 -> +0x44D, k 18 -> +0x44E all check out), but the k 7-10 clause drops 'signed' after the k 1-6 clause states it, reading as a different (unsigned) conversion: all ten dword cases are movd + cvtdq2ps (signed int32). The k 17/18 bytes are movzx (zero-extended) and the row does not say so.
